KibiBot Skill 1.5.2 Changelog

- Updated model list for Kibi LLM Gateway: added GPT 5.2 Chat, MiMo models, GLM models, and revised context window sizes.
- Removed Gemini 3 Pro from model list and reorganized ordering for clarity.
- Version bump only; no logic or functionality changes.

KibiBot Skill 1.5.1 — No code changes, documentation update only.

- Updated SKILL.md to reflect an expanded and renamed list of available LLM models and their configurations.
- Clarified OpenClaw model setup instructions and example config for more accurate usage.
- Added additional Gemini and GPT models to documentation.
- No changes to code or functionality; this is a docs-only release.

Initial release of the KibiBot skill.

- Create tokens on-chain across supported networks with natural language commands.
- Check your KibiBot Kibi Credit balance and daily token creation quota.
- Reload KibiBot credits from your trading wallet (with permission).
- View fee earnings from deployed tokens across chains and platforms.
- Access KibiBot's Agent API and Kibi LLM Gateway for AI model usage, billed to Kibi Credits.
- Easily integrate with OpenClaw, LangChain, CrewAI, and other OpenAI-compatible frameworks.
